notes.title: 📢 Version 1.0.3 Update is Live! 📢
notes.content:
Hey Mayhem Fans,

We're excited to announce that Multiplication Mayhem has just been updated to version 1.0.3, bringing some important bug fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience! Thanks to all of your feedback, we've been hard at work polishing up the game to ensure it runs smoothly for everyone.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

🛠 Fixed a bug on the victory screen: We’ve resolved an issue where the game would hang when clicking the "Next Level" button after completing a level.
🛠 Level progression fix: The Seraphin Boss Level, which was skipped after Level 6, is now back in its rightful place. Get ready to face the challenge!
🛠 HUD fix: We've fixed an issue where the HUD wasn’t always displaying the correct number of puzzle steps, giving you more accurate feedback during gameplay.
🛠 Dialog adjustments: Heracles' dialogue has been trimmed and altered to better fit the game's progression, ensuring a smoother and more cohesive story experience.
As always, your feedback is invaluable, so please let us know if you encounter any more bugs or have suggestions. Thanks for being part of this journey and for all your continued support!

Happy gaming and good luck conquering those levels! 😊🎮

notes.title: Roadmap: Exciting Three-Wave Update
notes.content:
Hello, Mayhem Masters!

We're thrilled to announce an exhilarating plan to bring a series of updates to Multiplication Mayhem Free Demo! Our team has been working tirelessly to enhance your experience, and we've decided to release these updates in three waves. This approach not only allows us to ensure each update is polished and bug-free but also means you'll get to enjoy new content sooner and in more manageable chunks.

[h2]Wave 1: Buffs and Animal Galore! 🐾[/h2]

Release Timing: In just a few days!
What’s New: Introducing a brand-new Buff/Animal Selector System! Now, you'll have the power to choose from 7 unique animals/buffs, including 4 exciting new additions. We've also made significant improvements to menus, added a new feedback form, and integrated an easy way to open the Steam overlay to Wishlist Multiplication Mayhem if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/83ea7c41340df8bfd5f2f604d1874a4cb9a53e5f.png[/img]

[h2]Wave 2: Campsite Chronicles 🏕️[/h2]

Coming Up Next: The campsite update will follow shortly after Wave 1. It introduces a freely explorable campsite area where you can interact with all the freed animals to dive deeper into the narrative story. It's a whole new way to experience the lore of Multiplication Mayhem, and it's almost ready for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/4b65c6c07abf85dd67e2ce25e1c440b0e933b75b.png[/img]

[h2]Wave 3: Temple of Trials 🏛️[/h2]

What to Expect: The third wave adds another layer of adventure with the ancient temple area, complete with a set of intriguing puzzles and key narrative progressions. This update will deepen the game's story and challenge your problem-solving skills like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/5c364c56500f2d2c679e0c81238b28a4324a277a.png[/img]

[h2]Looking Ahead: Beta Testing Sign-Ups[/h2]

After the excitement of these three updates, our sights are set on the beta version of Multiplication Mayhem. We'll share details on how you can sign up to become a beta tester, offering you an exclusive glimpse into the future of the game and the opportunity to help shape its development.

[h2]Stay Tuned and Engaged[/h2]

We're incredibly excited to bring these updates to you and can't wait for you to dive into all the new content. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in getting us this far, and we're eager to hear your thoughts on these upcoming additions.

Stay tuned to our Steam Community page for the latest news, and don't hesitate to share your excitement and feedback with us. Together, we're making Multiplication Mayhem not just a game, but an unforgettable adventure.

Thank you for being an essential part of this journey. Get ready for a mayhem-filled update experience like no other!

Warm regards,

The Multiplication Mayhem Team

notes.title: 🌟 Introducing the New Spirit Animal/Buff Selector UI 🌟
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Adventurers,[/h2]

We're thrilled to announce a brand-new feature that's going to make your journey through "Multiplication Mayhem" even more thrilling and strategic: the Spirit Animal/Buff Selector UI! This feature is not just a visual treat but also a game-changer in how you approach your puzzles and challenges.

[h2]🐾 What’s New?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/cb20df492b4b3f72508fdfdfef9e52400182198b.png[/img]

[b]Choose Your Companions:[/b] Now, you can have up to three animals/buffs active at a time. Each animal comes with unique buffs to aid you in your quest.

[b]Unlock More Allies:[/b] As you conquer multiplication puzzles on different islands, you unlock more animals. Your collection grows, and so does your power!

[b]Easy Management:[/b] Changing active buffs is a breeze. Simply click the edit button on any of the three active buffs to access a grid displaying all available animals, along with question marks for those yet to be rescued.

[b]Detailed Insight:[/b] Selecting an animal brings up a side-panel with everything you need to know: the Animal's Name, Description, Buff Name, Buff Description, Buff Recharge Rate, and Buff Duration.

[b]Assign with Ease:[/b] The UI shows which animal is assigned to which buttons (1,2,3 on Keyboard or B, Y, X on controllers) in a neat circle at the bottom right of the animal’s portrait.

[b]Stylish and Cute:[/b] The design seamlessly fits with the overall aesthetic of "Multiplication Mayhem," and the animal portraits maintain the adorable cartoon style you all love.

[h2]🎮 Enhance Your Gameplay[/h2]

This new feature is not just about looks; it's about bringing a deeper strategic layer to your gameplay. Plan your moves, select buffs that complement your style, and embark on a more personalized and exciting journey.

[h2]👀 Sneak Peek[/h2]

Here's a glimpse of what this new UI looks like!

[h2]🙌 We Want Your Feedback![/h2]

We're always looking to improve and make "Multiplication Mayhem" the best it can be. 
It will be available in the next Demo Update!

Let us know what you think. Your feedback is invaluable!

Get ready to unleash the power of your new animal friends and buffs!

Happy Gaming,
Kory Code

notes.title: Unleash the Power of Ares!
notes.content:
[h2]🔥 New Spirit Animal Alert: Ares Joins the Battle in Multiplication Mayhem! 🔥[/h2]

[b]Attention Mayhem Warriors![/b]

Get ready for a powerful new addition to our growing family of spirit animals in "Multiplication Mayhem" – Ares, the Mighty Rhinoceros!

[b]🦏 Meet Ares: The Embodiment of Strength and Determination 🦏[/b]
Ares isn't just a spirit animal; it's a symbol of unstoppable force and unwavering resolve. Inspired by the Greek god of war, Ares the Rhinoceros brings its formidable strength and fearless nature to our game's universe. With a body built like a tank, and a presence that commands respect, Ares is here to show you what it means to be truly indomitable. Its thick, armour-like skin and mighty horn are not just awe-inspiring – they represent resilience and the ability to conquer any challenge that blocks your path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/f810bed01dca9afad0cee66da311ab7c21119ce0.gif[/img]

When you activate this buff, Ares charges across the platforms, skilfully eliminating 3 false answers in your way. This not only clears your path but also symbolizes the breaking down of learning barriers, fostering a fearless and strategic approach to problem-solving.

[b]🌟 Coming Soon to Multiplication Mayhem 🌟[/b]
We are thrilled to bring Ares into our world and can't wait for you to experience the sheer power and determination it embodies. Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare to charge into your mathematical battles like never before!

Stay strong,
KoryCode

notes.title: 🎉 Free Demo is Here! Explore Early Levels & Meet Our First Spirit Animals 🐾
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Multiplication Masters and Math Enthusiasts![/h2]

We are thrilled to announce something special for our beloved "Multiplication Mayhem" community! As a token of our gratitude for your support and enthusiasm, we are releasing a [b]FREE Demo[/b] of "Multiplication Mayhem" on Steam. This demo is not just a sneak peek into the game; it's an adventure into a world where math meets mythology, where numbers are not just digits, but gateways to mastering challenges with the help of some magical spirit animals.

Whether you're a long-time fan or a newcomer eager to dive into the world of fun-filled math learning, this demo is the perfect way to get a taste of the excitement that "Multiplication Mayhem" offers. So, gear up to embark on a journey that combines learning with mythical adventures!

[h2]Demo Highlights:[/h2]

Levels of Learning and Fun:

[b]Experience the Early Challenges:[/b] The demo features levels from 1x to 6x, tailored to both beginners and those looking to refresh their multiplication skills. These levels are available in a structured, ordered format and also in a randomized mode for an extra challenge.

[b]Special Square Levels:[/b] As a unique twist, the demo includes special levels focused on square numbers. Just like the standard levels, these too come in both ordered and randomized formats, adding an extra layer of fun and education.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/8793bb929f73d73bda6dced149161e36a6f9834c.png[/img]

[h2]Meet Your Mythical Helpers:[/h2]

Apollo the Wolf, Hermes the Ostrich, and Artemis the Cat: These first three spirit animals, inspired by Greek mythology, will be your guides and helpers in the game. Each comes with its unique buff - from Apollo's problem-solving howl to Hermes' speedy strides, and Artemis' life-renewing grace. These buffs not only add an exciting dimension to the gameplay but also embody the spirit of learning and overcoming challenges.

[h3]Apollo[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/eabb8cd5f37e27a2e8d9cd5a49dad4159d08ac91.png[/img]

[b]Description[/b]: Apollo the Wolf, majestic and wise, roams the levels with a keen eye and a protective stance. His silvery fur glistens under the moonlight, symbolizing both intelligence and agility.
[b]Buff Name[/b]: Wolf Howling
[b]Buff Effect Description[/b]: When invoked, Apollo's howl resonates through the game, dispelling confusion by removing 6 false tiles from the board. He then marks 3 tiles, guiding players towards potential correct answers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/22d621350b7a87f49e9a9c233488c79925f479c3.png[/img]

[h3]Hermes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/4e698e21c1882acc706dd4689a5ee307c05a769d.png[/img]

[b]Description[/b]: Hermes the Ostrich, named after the swift messenger god, dashes across the game world with remarkable speed. His long legs and alert eyes represent quick thinking and rapid responses, essential for overcoming challenges.
[b]Buff Name:[/b] Speed Surge
[b]Buff Effect Description:[/b] Unleashing Hermes’ buff grants players a burst of speed, allowing them to navigate levels and solve problems more quickly. This buff is perfect for beating the clock and achieving higher scores.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/df2400db0766bd9a422866b8e7e95a7630d1e5b4.png[/img]

[h3]Artemis[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/dd91922ce4259dec32ef6f891e1b96c6c385b765.png[/img]

[b]Description:[/b] Artemis the Cat, embodying the grace and agility of the huntress goddess, moves with silent steps and a watchful gaze. Her sleek coat and bright eyes inspire confidence and a sense of security.
[b]Buff Name:[/b] Nine Lives
[b]Buff Effect Description:[/b] Artemis lends her resilience to players, granting them a second chance by recovering a lost heart. This buff symbolizes rejuvenation and the ability to tackle obstacles with renewed vigour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/9d55d8815c380f2d3f446f9d26f3acfa86512a85.png[/img]

[h2]First Glimpse into the Magical World: [/h2]
The demo is designed to give you a real taste of what "Multiplication Mayhem" has in store. It's not just about mastering multiplication; it's about embarking on an adventure where each level is a step towards becoming a math wizard.

[h2]Inspiration from Greek Mythology:[/h2]
In "Multiplication Mayhem," we don't just play with numbers; we delve into a realm where ancient myths come alive. Our spirit animals - Apollo the Wolf, Hermes the Ostrich, and Artemis the Cat - are not just whimsical characters; they're deeply rooted in Greek mythology. Apollo, the god of knowledge, lends his name to our wise and guiding wolf. Hermes, known for his incredible speed, inspires our swift ostrich. And Artemis, the goddess of the hunt and protector, is the namesake for our life-giving cat. These mythological figures embody the strengths and skills we hope to pass on to our players as they navigate through the world of math and learning.


Ready to join this mythical adventure and sharpen your multiplication skills? 

The free demo of "Multiplication Mayhem" will be available for you on Steam in [b]mid Dec 2023[/b]! 

Your feedback is invaluable to us. After trying out the demo, please share your thoughts, suggestions! Your input helps us make "Multiplication Mayhem" even more magical.

Thank you for being a part of our growing community. Your enthusiasm and support are what drive us to create engaging and educational experiences. We can't wait to hear about your adventures with Apollo, Hermes, and Artemis in the world of "Multiplication Mayhem." Happy multiplying, and may your journey through numbers be as exciting as the myths that inspire us!

notes.title: Multiplication Mayhem's Vibrant New Look
notes.content:
[h2]🎨 A Splash of Colour in Multiplication Mayhem![/h2]
We're thrilled to announce an exciting visual upgrade to Multiplication Mayhem! Our latest update introduces a dynamic new colour scheme, blending soothing shades of light blue and pink with a touch of dark brown. This refreshing palette perfectly complements our unique 2D cartoon shader, enhancing the 3D environments you know and love.

[h2]🖥️ HUD Gets a Facelift![/h2]
Our HUD has undergone a total makeover! We've strategically placed different elements in the corners within rounded boxes, ensuring a seamless gaming experience. Here's a sneak peek:

[list]
[*] Top Right: Animated life-representing hearts, now in a charming lighter pink.
[*] Top Left: Score and bonuses, nestled in light blue and pink boxes.
[*] Bottom Right: Progress bar, showcasing level advancements with pink (for missed opportunities) and light blue (for successes).
[*] Bottom Left: Revamped buff holders, indicating your three selected buffs and their statuses.
